newsitem.title: USA: Copley gets FDA OK for cholesterol powder.
newsitem.headline: Copley gets FDA OK for cholesterol powder.

text.p: Copley Pharmaceutical Inc said Friday it has received approval from the Food and Drug Administration to manufacture and market cholestyramine powder, which is used to lower blood serum cholesterol.
The company had submitted an Abbreviated New Drug Application. It said the powder will be available in 378 gram multi-dose cans and in cartons containing 60 nine-gram pouches.
Copley said cholestyramine powder is bioequivalent and therefore therapeutically equivalent to Bristol-Myers Squibb Co's Questran.
